programs.description: Ramachandran joins the office as the managing director and develops feelings for the office stenographer. Later, he realises it's the same girl who walked out on him on their wedding day.
Pramila's mother reveals to her that she was married twice and both her husbands had left her. Pramila later falls in love with Jose and discovers that he is her brother.
Bhaskaran, a goldsmith, is madly in love with Snehalatha, the daughter of the astrologer, Panicker. When he asks for her hand in marriage, to his shock, she denies their love affair.
Bringing the best in television.
A wealthy philanderer falls in love with a divorced woman while his partner finds solace in a guide, but their lives change when they face the truth.
Eby, who hails from a wealthy family, falls in love with Ilina, but her family opposes their relationship. At Eby's insistence, her uncle reveals the shocking reason that could change their future.
Kunjamma and her sons run a business and lead a successful life. When Chennaikara, a thug, threatens them, her eldest son is determined to fight against him.
Balu is forced to follow the family profession of fortune-telling against his dream of becoming a film actor. His life changes when some of his predictions come true and he becomes famous.

An ex-gangster decides to move into his village with his sister. However, chaos ensues when a businessman frames him and gets him arrested.
Following the death of his ex-wife, a retired police officer, who is known for his investigative prowess, unexpectedly gets pulled into a criminal case involving organ harvesting.
CID officers Ramdas and Vijayan go to Kerala to find the murderer of a police officer. While doing so, they face a dangerous crime syndicate that deals in drug trafficking.
When Shyamala's corpse is brought home, her family and people close to her recollect fond memories of her and contemplate her suicide.
Nandini is a bookworm who always wanted a writer for a husband. However, by binding her in marriage with a businessman, life teaches her that she may not always get what she wishes for.
While driving in an inebriated state, Vishnu hits a man and kills him. When he tries to help the victim's family, he falls in love with his daughter but hides from her that he has killed her father.

A group of youngsters, who are frustrated with the unjust society, decide to abduct the popular Malayalam actor Prem Nazir to express their anger.
Young and pure of heart, Madhavan is adored by every single one of his villagers. However, a false accusation of two murders alters the course of his life.
After many years, Dharman, a rich man, goes back to his village to take revenge against Thommichan, a businessman, for ruining his family.
A man, who harbours feelings for his childhood friend, hides the truth from his best friend. However, trouble arises when his best friend falls in love with her.

A greedy man tries every method possible to get rich and hoard more money. However, things take a turn when he accidentally gets his own son killed.
Raja takes the blame for a murder committed by his father and is deserted by him. Years later, his father comes seeking his help when his younger brother, Surya, is falsely imprisoned.
Police officers Sudheendran, Balachandran and Jayadevan are tasked to find a culprit, who brutally murdered the family of IG Sekharan Thampi.

Sunil marries Varma's mentally disabled sister, then attempts to kill her, as police investigate his motives for these shocking actions.
Diwakaran, a thief, steals jewellery from Aravindakshan, a school teacher. Jayashankar, a police officer who in reality is Diwakaran's brother-in-law, is appointed to investigate the case.

Bharathan, a communist, works for the welfare of the people. He soon faces many challenges when he encounters an evil businessman.
An artist falls in love with a woman who is about to get married to someone else. Things become complicated when the woman develops feelings for the artist as well.
When Anand visits Hyderabad, he encounters Sathyam, who operates an organisation aiding the underprivileged. Sathyam, swayed by Anand's vision, hands over the organisation's management to him.
Vava, a villager, goes through many troubles as he is born to a Christian mother and a Brahmin father. However, he is determined to prove to the society that love matters the most.

Gopinadhan and Mathunni steal money from the rich and distribute it amongst the needy. When Mathunni robs Maya, Gopinadhan returns it and falls in love with her.
Two brothers, both moneylenders, hate each other and extend their mutual hatred to their families as well. However, they face several obstacles that intensify after their estrangement.
Two men, a writer and his friend, travel to an abandoned bungalow, unaware that it is haunted. However, when they reach, they meet a ghost who narrates his miserable life story to them.

When a judge's enemies decide to seek revenge, they harm his son and daughter. They even bring in his lookalike to further malign his image in society, who in reality turns out to be his estranged son.
When Annie encounters her ex-lover, Tommy, after years, Tommy is oblivious to the fact that he is the father of Annie's child and Annie is unaware of the reason behind Tommy's betrayal in the past.
A thief and his family decide to mend their ways and start afresh. Things take an awry turn when they find themselves embroiled in local issues.

Sherly, an orphan, falls in love with Roy not knowing that he is her financial supporter. However, Roy keeps his distance from her due to their age gap.
Kalan Varkey, a butcher, faces a lot of trouble when a buffalo he was supposed to slaughter goes astray and causes chaos in a remote village.
A hard-working postwoman lives a contended life with her adopted son. However, her simple life is jeopardised after her beloved son is imprisoned under a false charge.
Sunny, a successful businessman in Singapore, wishes to marry his girlfriend, Sandra. However, he soon finds out that she is an escort hired by his business rival, Mohammad Ali, to spy on him.

When his father asks him to manage their grocery store, Umesh runs away to Chennai to become a film-maker. His life changes after he takes a selfie with his old neighbour and posts it online.
Balan, a barber, struggles to give his family a better living. However, his life changes when his old friend, who is a film star, comes to his village for a film shoot.
Two rival family groups ask a mediator to choose who will run their upcoming religious event. However, the mediator uses this chance to uncover a hidden family secret.
Gautham, a security guard, comes across his grandfather's diary that takes him on a treasure hunt. Meanwhile, Sultan, a terrorist, holds a Pakistani archaeologist hostage to find a treasure.
Geetha's murder is pinned on Ramu, the man she rejected, while the real culprits, Johnny, Rahim, Swami and Kannan, get off scot-free. However, the four spoilt brats fail to elude their karma.
Sultan, a labourer, tries to save his community from an evil bourgeoisie. He decides to take down their oppressors and help his people in leading a respectable life.

Balachandran comes under family pressure and marries Lekha. However, when he chooses to not have children, chaos ensues within his family.
When a gang of criminals kidnaps Johnny's son, he is left with no choice but to work with Lawrence, his estranged father, to save him.
After marriage, Sukumaran's wife Kanchana demands a glamorous lifestyle. However, Sukumaran, who finds it difficult to fulfil her wishes, takes a loan which he is later unable to repay.
When Alexander, a prominent leader, is falsely accused of murdering a CM, Danny, his nephew, navigates a web of political intrigue and danger to uncover the truth and prove Alexander's innocence.

Sundaresan, a grocery store owner, marries an educated girl who gets a good job in another city soon after the wedding. Though he follows her to the new city, he plots so that she resigns.
Trouble ensues after a bear escapes from the zoo and the zookeeper must find the animal. So, he disguises himself as a bear to save his job.
When an honest doctor tries to stop a burglary, his entire family is killed. Balachandra, a fierce police officer, comes to his rescue and helps him fight for justice.
Two carefree friends, Nithin and Anand, cross paths with the same woman, setting off a chain of misunderstandings that tests their bond and changes their lives.
